items.title: How to Keep Up with AI Without Burning Out: A Weekly System
items.pt:
Originally published on AI Tech Connect.

Key takeaways Comprehensive reading is impossible and pretending otherwise is the root cause of AI-news burnout. The goal is decision-readiness, not coverage. Tier your sources. Primary sources (lab blogs, release notes, arXiv) outrank curated newsletters, which outrank social feeds. Spend your attention in that order. Time-box everything. Three 30-minute scans plus one 90-minute deep dive a week is enough. More input does not produce more understanding.
items.en:

items.title: Lévy Attention: Single-Pass Predictive Uncertainty for Continuous-Time Attention
items.pt: Deep models for irregularly-sampled time series answer queries at arbitrary continuous timestamps, yet report nothing about how far each answer should be trusted.
